info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Offers Management API
info.description: The Loan Offers Management API allows users to update specific loan offers related to loan applications. This endpoint is crucial for editing details such as terms, rates, and conditions of offers in response to changing user needs or application statuses. Typically, loan officers and financial service applications consume this API to keep offers accurate and relevant. By facilitating targeted updates, the API ensures that applicants receive the most up-to-date information and options available to them.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific loan application offer identified by the given resource ID. Ensure all necessary fields are included in the request to successfully modify the offer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the loan application offers for a specific application identified by RES-100045. The data provided must adhere to the schema defined for loan application offers.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the offer has been updated.
